prompt: A painterly anime fantasy background painting, a cinematic matte painting with visible brushwork, sunset, an orange, pink and violet sky, the sun low on the left, long warm light. The view is from on top of the back of a colossal flying monster, high above the clouds: the ground is a broad rolling expanse of huge overlapping dark slate-grey scales like weathered stone plates, rising towards a spine of tall stone spikes that runs away to the upper right; on the left the back drops away to a sea of clouds far below. A small airship flies in the sky far off on the left. In the middle of the scaled back crouches a monstrous shelled creature as big as a house: a hunched beast under a massive ridged dome shell of dark craggy stone plates twice the height of a man like a giant clam, open at the front, from which its thick grey-violet body leans out, a heavy crested head, two thick clawed forelimbs gripping the scales. Behind it and higher up the back, out of reach on a raised hump of scales, a huge round core is set into the monster's back like a great dark pearl in a crater of scales, faintly lit violet, with veins running out from it into the scales. It is a grotesque, menacing fiend, the strongest spawn of the great monster: a wide maw of jagged fangs, small glaring red eyes deep under a heavy armoured brow, rough dark grey-violet hide; not cute, not a frog, not a cartoon animal. No people.
